description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Haggai tells the returned exiles that their harvests fail because they live in paneled houses while God's house lies in ruins. Zerubbabel, Joshua and the people obey and begin to rebuild.
1.sw: Hagai anawaambia waliorudi kutoka uhamishoni kwamba mavuno yao yanashindwa kwa sababu wanaishi katika nyumba zilizopambwa kwa mbao wakati nyumba ya Mungu imebaki magofu. Zerubabeli, Yoshua na watu wanatii na kuanza kujenga upya.
1.am: ሐጌ ከስደት ለተመለሱት የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ፈርሶ ሳለ እነርሱ በእንጨት በተለበጡ ቤቶች ስለሚኖሩ መከራቸው እንደሚከሽፍ ይነግራቸዋል። ዘሩባቤል፣ ኢያሱና ሕዝቡ ይታዘዛሉ፤ እንደ ገናም መሥራት ይጀምራሉ።

2.en: God promises that the glory of the new house will be greater than the old, and that from today God will bless them. God will make Zerubbabel like a signet ring.
2.sw: Mungu anaahidi kwamba utukufu wa nyumba mpya utakuwa mkuu kuliko wa ile ya zamani, na kwamba kuanzia leo Mungu atawabariki. Mungu atamfanya Zerubabeli kama pete ya muhuri.
2.am: እግዚአብሔር የአዲሱ ቤት ክብር ከቀድሞው እንደሚበልጥና ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እንደሚባርካቸው ተስፋ ይሰጣል። እግዚአብሔር ዘሩባቤልን እንደ ማኅተም ቀለበት ያደርገዋል።
